heading.en: Many Nephites migrate to the land northward—They build houses of cement and keep many records—Tens of thousands are converted and baptized—The word of God leads men to salvation—Nephi the son of Helaman fills the judgment seat. About 49–39 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua malaga atu le toatele o sa Nifaē i le laueleele i matu—Ua latou fausia fale sima ma tausia talafaamaumau e tele—Ua faaliliu mai ma papatisoina le sefulu o afe ma afe—O le afioga a le Atua e taitai atu ai tagata i le olataga—Ua nofo Nifae, le atalii o Helamana, i le nofoa-faamasino. E tusa o le 49–39 T.L.M.
